name: cantilena
description: Sings the lyrics of a score for notation extensions such as Lily#: notes with syllables in, a voice out — through your own installation of NEUTRINO (Japanese voices). Open source (Apache-2.0); runs locally on Windows.

cantilena.neutrinoFolder.markdownDescription:
The folder of your NEUTRINO installation (Tau, v3.2 or later): the one holding `bin\`, `model\` and `settings\`. NEUTRINO is not bundled — it is free software of STUDIO NEUTRINO under its own terms, from [studio-neutrino.com](https://studio-neutrino.com/). Empty: nothing can be sung.

**[Choose the folder…](command:cantilena.chooseNeutrinoFolder)**

cantilena.voice.markdownDescription:
The voice the lyrics are sung in, as `engine/name`: for NEUTRINO, `neutrino/` and a folder under its `model\` (MERROW ships with NEUTRINO; other voices are their authors' work under their authors' terms, installed there by you). A bare name means a NEUTRINO voice.

**[Choose a voice…](command:cantilena.chooseVoice)**

cantilena.gpu.markdownDescription: Render on the GPU when NEUTRINO can (CUDA). Off: the CPU, slower by an order of magnitude.

cantilena.program.markdownDescription: For developers: the `cantilena` program to run instead of the one bundled with this extension (a build from the repository).
